ModMetaData.name: Roo's Minotaur - Fur Leg Patch
ModMetaData.author: DanZinagri
ModMetaData.description: Compatibility patch: Roo's Minotaur Xenotype draws the "UnguligradeLegs" fur overlay masked directly against the vanilla (male/unisex) Fat and Hulk body silhouettes, ignoring FemaleBodyVariants' female Fat/Hulk textures. This patch makes the leg overlay's mask follow the same female body path FemaleBodyVariants already resolved for the base body, so the legs match the female Fat/Hulk shape instead of the male one.
